instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a module that takes in a 4-bit input and outputs the binary representation of the input in BCD (binary-coded decimal) format. The module should have one input (A) and two outputs (OUT1 and OUT2). The output should be the BCD representation of the input, which is calculated by converting each decimal digit of the input into its binary representation. For example, if the input is 0010 (which represents the decimal number 2), the output should be 0000 (for OUT1) and 0010 (for OUT2).
